summary: Lists root-level PowerShell argument spec keys: mutually_exclusive, no_log, options, required_by, required_if (3 or 4 elements), required_one_of, required_together and supports_check_mode.
questions: How do I make two PowerShell module options mutually exclusive?
How does required_if work in a Windows module spec?
How do I enable check mode in a PowerShell module?

answer_card.title: PowerShell argument spec root options
answer_card.answer_md:
- `mutually_exclusive`: lists of options that can't be set together
- `no_log`: stop logging to the Windows Event log
- `options`: option name → spec
- `required_by`: key set ⇒ value options required
- `required_if`: `[option, value, [required...], <any_one?>]` (4th is `$true` for only one required)
- `required_one_of`, `required_together`
- `supports_check_mode`: default `$false`
